preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t representing the number of test cases, where 1 ≤ t ≤ 10⁴.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == len(s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: Each of the t test cases consists of exactly one line containing a string s of lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: sum(len(s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]]) <= 3 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The total length of all strings across all test cases does not exceed 3·10⁵.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] for output_line in stdout.splitlines() if output_line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the first line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.splitlines()[i*2+1]) == len(s) + 1 if stdout.splitlines()[i*2].strip() == 'YES' else True for i, s in enumerate([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]]))
postconditions.description: If the answer for a test case is 'YES', the next line contains a string of length |s| + 1.

postconditions.expression: all((s + 'a')[i] == s[i] if i < len(s) else 'a' == 'a' for i in range(len(s) + 1)) if stdout.splitlines()[i*2].strip() == 'YES' else True for i, s in enumerate([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]]))
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the constructed string is formed by inserting exactly one 'a' into s.

postconditions.expression: all((s + 'a')[i] != (s + 'a')[len(s) + 1 - i - 1] for i in range((len(s) + 1) // 2)) if stdout.splitlines()[i*2].strip() == 'YES' else True for i, s in enumerate([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]]))
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the constructed string is not a palindrome.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i*2].strip() == 'NO' if all((s + 'a')[j] == (s + 'a')[len(s) + 1 - j - 1] for j in range((len(s) + 1) // 2)) else True for i, s in enumerate([line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]]))
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'NO', it means inserting 'a' anywhere in s results in a palindrome.
